description: What heavy industry already operates near a Texas address or coordinate (TCEQ emissions-inventory sites with industry and NOx tons per year) and what has recently applied for TCEQ air permits nearby (gas plants, data centers, industrial projects, with received and issued dates, MW where known and a data-center flag). Use when someone asks whether a site is in an industrial area, what is being built nearby before it shows in the ERCOT queue, or about air-permit and neighbor context for a large load or generator.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

name: industrial_neighbors
title: Industrial neighbors and air permits near a site
